name: Boston Shaded Italic 1832
description: Swash italic titling capitals with an open face and cast shadow, from the Boston foundry’s 1832 specimen.
observed: Complete A–Z capitals from Shaded Two Line Pearl Italic, with matching larger Shaded Two Line Minion Italic L, M, figures, currency and punctuation on archive leaf111.
reconstructed: No inferred visible characters. Lowercase input aliases capitals; ASCII apostrophe aliases the observed closing apostrophe. Blank spaces, metrics and digital spacing are new.

sources.title: Boston Type and Stereotype Foundry specimen (1832), shaded or Italian display types, unnumbered leaf 111
sources.rights: 1832 US publication, public domain by age. Library of Congress scan distributed through Internet Archive. The retained archive metadata states that the Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item. No modern font or redrawing was traced. MIT applies to original project work.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Native JP2 and exact quarter-turn retained. Connected-component groups and explicit separation of the touching L/I are recorded; row baseline fits correct scan tilt without removing the italic slant.

character_set_notes: Complete historical titling alphabet, all ten figures and observed symbols. Lowercase aliases capitals. Unsupported modern symbols are omitted.
